"### Master Prompt for AI Game Maker (Copy @COMMENT_BODY@ Paste)

> **Project Title:** Web-Slinger: City of Shadows
> **Genre:** 3D Open-World Action-Adventure / Superhero Simulator
> **Visual Style:** Cinematic next-gen realism mixed with vibrant comic-book lighting (golden hour sunsets, neon-lit rainy nights, dynamic motion blur, and crisp character shaders).
> **Core Gameplay Loop @COMMENT_BODY@ Mechanics:**
> 1. **Physics-Based Web-Swinging:** Implement momentum-driven pendulum physics. Webs must physically attach to actual building geometry—never empty sky. Include a \"Web-Zip\" button to pull the player toward specific ledges, a \"Point Launch\" mechanic to catapult off rooftops, and mid-air acrobatic tricks that build a style meter.
> 2. **Parkour @COMMENT_BODY@ Wall-Crawling:** Seamless transitions between running on the ground, sprinting vertically up skyscrapers, and vaulting over rooftop obstacles without losing momentum.
> 3. **Acrobatic Combat System:** Fast-paced, rhythm-based melee combat inspired by free-flow fighting games. Include light/heavy combos, air-juggling, web-strikes to close distance, gadget wheel selection (Impact Webs, Web-Bombs, Electric Webs), and environmental takedowns (yanking scaffolding or throwing objects).
> 4. **Spider-Sense Mechanic:** Display a glowing white/red visual ripple around the hero's head right before an enemy attacks or shoots, giving the player a brief window to execute a \"Perfect Dodge\" that slows down time and triggers a cinematic counter-attack.
> 
> 
> **World @COMMENT_BODY@ Environment:**
> * **Setting:** A dense, living metropolis modeled after Manhattan, divided into distinct districts (Financial District, Times Square-style neon hub, Industrial Docks, and Central Park).
> * **Atmosphere:** Dynamic day-night cycle and weather system (clear sunny days, overcast afternoons, and rainy nights with wet, reflective asphalt). Populate streets with moving traffic, pedestrians who cheer or take photos when the hero lands nearby, and dynamic random crimes (car chases, rooftop muggings, armored truck heists).
> 
> 
> **Cinematic Story @COMMENT_BODY@ Mission Structure:**
> * **Tone:** Emotional, cinematic, and high-stakes—balancing witty, quippy dialogue during combat with intense, movie-like cutscenes.
> * **Main Story Arc:** A mysterious tech syndicate is equipping street gangs with experimental energy weapons while a masked armored villain targets the city's power grid.
> * **Mission Types:**
> 1. *Main Story Missions:* Scripted, cinematic set-pieces (e.g., stopping a runaway elevated train, fighting a boss while falling down the side of a glass skyscraper).
> 2. *Stealth Infiltrations:* Perching on ceiling rafters in warehouse bases to silently web-up guards one by one without triggering alarms.
> 3. *Time-Trial Challenges:* High-speed web-swinging courses through tight alleyways and under bridges.
> 
> 
> 
> 
> **UI, Audio @COMMENT_BODY@ Polish:**
> * **HUD:** Minimalist interface. Show a sleek health/focus bar in the top-left, a circular mini-map in the bottom-right, and a subtle crosshair in the center that highlights valid web-swinging anchor points.
> * **Audio:** Orchestral, heroic brass-heavy soundtrack that swells dynamically as the player swings faster and reaches higher altitudes. Include realistic wind-rushing sound effects, crisp *thwip* web-shooter audio, and adaptive combat sound effects.
> 
> 

---

### Tips for Using This Prompt in AI Game Makers

* **For Text-to-Game Platforms (e.g., Rosebud AI, Scenario, Unity Muse, or GPT-powered engines):** Paste the prompt in chunks if the tool has a character limit. Start with **Core Gameplay Loop @COMMENT_BODY@ Mechanics** first so the AI gets the swinging physics right before adding the story and city details.
* **For 3D Asset @COMMENT_BODY@ Environment Generators:** Copy the **World @COMMENT_BODY@ Environment** and **Visual Style** sections separately into your level-design tool to generate matching building textures and lighting.
* **Iterative Tweaking:** If the AI makes the swinging feel too floaty, follow up with: *\"Increase gravity by 30% during web-swinging and add a forward speed boost when releasing the web at the bottom of the pendulum arc.\"*

Which AI game maker or engine are you planning to paste this into? I can tailor the formatting or break it into step-by-step code prompts if needed.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
